newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-WELSH WING EVANS JOINS BATH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WELSH WING EVANS JOINS BATH.

text.p: Wales and British Lions winger Ieuan Evans joined English rugby union club Bath on Friday after 13 years at Llanelli.
The 33-year-old, Wales' most capped player and top try-scorer, has signed a two-year deal after the clubs agreed a transfer fee believed to be around 75,000 pounds ($119,000).

Evans, who has played 71 times for Wales, 28 times as captain, and scored 33 tries, has been on three British Lions tours -- 1989, 1993 and 1997 -- playing in seven successive tests before a groin injury curtailed his South African tour in June.
